description:
Resolve the final documentation review findings concerning lifecycle transitions, gate execution and statuses, assignment and claim behavior, type-label requirements, and invalid command examples.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The assigned lifecycle and gate documentation precisely matches the current CLI and command handlers, including initial state, precheck failure, Gated completion, and the pending/passed/failed gate statuses.
- [hard] REQ-02: Assignment, issue-claim, claim-next, and advisory-lease coordination claims state only behavior implemented by the current code.
- [hard] REQ-03: All changed CLI and jq examples are syntactically valid and match their actual command contracts.
- [hard] REQ-04: Scoped mechanical documentation checks and repository validation pass.
title: Correct lifecycle, gate, and coordination documentation semantics
